criterion_fired: Criterion 1 (Complete Coverage) and Criterion 5 (No Unsupported Claims)
suggested_change: Criterion 1 should explicitly permit 'classification hold' status: 'All seven components have status and scores OR a documented classification hold with rationale explaining why MEDDICC qualification is suspended pending prerequisite resolution.' Criterion 5 should clarify that contradictions between CRM data and call evidence should trigger a 'verify classification' step, not failure of the entire assessment.
